notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42900707/d69eccaaa19f198e4df88f54fb58bae3bc2ebe16.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for everyone who has been following the game for so long. We are happy to announce that "Soul Dier - Part 1" will be released on [b]24/10/2025[/b]![/p]
